motivation: Gate B.0 adds deterministic experimental DSH Launcher runtime workspace identity binding and one-app multi-workspace acceptance, with protected verifier tests updated to cover the new evidence contract.
invariants: Production Kernel, ABI, workspace scope, approval authority, production trusted runtime, and dependencies remain unchanged. The experimental Launcher only supplements the existing user-selected security-scoped workspace, Kernel scope checks, approval digest, device/inode validation, marker integrity, and result identity validation. DSH receives no directory authority.
authority_delta: 0 production Kernel authority, 0 Kernel ABI, 0 production workspace-scope authority, 0 production trusted-runtime delta, 0 production dependencies, 0 new production processes or IPC operations. The disposable signed test-app Launcher overlay gains runtime trial-to-workspace consistency checks and fails closed on identity mismatch.
real_os_tests: A no-model app built with the repository signing path passed deep/strict signature verification and exact-source prebuilt validation. Focused tests passed (8 builder, 14 runner; pinned DSH 19 semantic and 17 bridge/lifecycle). Two signed Trial A attempts each selected a disposable workspace and approved one scoped read; Kernel/Runner returned successfully with no workspace mutation, but result delivery failed at successive experimental schema boundaries. The first Host rejected the runtime_trial_id field in the Launcher trace as invalid_request. After that correction, the Host rejected DSH terminal-result telemetry because runtime_trial_id was missing from its Swift telemetry allowlist. The Launcher-client telemetry filter also needed to validate and preserve that field. These filters now allow the UUID-shaped ID only on the terminal-result event; focused tests pass. A fresh corrected signed build and trials, final canonical suite and final Security Freeze runs remain pending.
trusted_delta: Production trusted source delta is 0. The disposable signed DSH app's experimental Trusted Launcher overlay binds a fresh runtime trial to the actual Picker bookmark, rechecks workspace and marker identity around approval and Kernel result handling, and includes the runtime trial ID in its bounded result trace. Experimental protocol, Host telemetry, and Launcher-client telemetry filters validate and preserve the UUID-shaped ID at each boundary. No new authority is added and the overlay is not installed into the production app. Both failed signed attempts and their fail-closed outcomes are disclosed; independent security review and corrected signed acceptance remain required.
baseline_decision: Update only the protected DSH acceptance-test hashes and the aggregate manifest digest. Record exact PR #47 base e27aed3ee3f40e7a008517ab7d8242bebe25a7c2. Independent Security review of the experimental Launcher delta remains pending; this declaration and passing tests are not approval.
